subject.title: fix(install): validate downloaded scripts before execution

question: Should OpenClaw's installer fail closed whenever one of these four trusted third-party script responses does not begin with raw `#!` bytes?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and current upstream scripts comply, but choosing structural fail-closed behavior over tolerance of future upstream formatting changes requires explicit installer/security intent.

options.title: Adopt raw-shebang validation
options.body: Keep the patch and treat future upstream formatting changes as installer compatibility events requiring an OpenClaw update.

options.title: Keep transfer guards only
options.body: Abort failed downloads but remove structural rejection to avoid coupling installation availability to upstream first-byte formatting.

recommendation.title: Adopt raw-shebang validation
recommendation.body: Keep the patch and treat future upstream formatting changes as installer compatibility events requiring an OpenClaw update.
